scope: Eight bounded source-reviewed design references; not exhaustive, ranked, code-audited or playtested. Canonical discovery remains Herbertofury/Games.

records.name: Command & Conquer Generals Zero Hour
records.evidence_scope: EA announcement February 27, 2025; source availability, not code audit
observations: EA released Generals and Zero Hour source under GPL.
EA describes community tournaments and modding support.
records.design_interpretation: Study actual source for simulation, command handling and extensibility separately; do not mistake source availability for modern portability or asset rights.
acceptance: Pin source revision and audit licenses before reuse.
Evaluate RTS economy, scouting, counters, production, pathfinding and replay determinism, not survivor timers.
records.reuse: Original analysis only; no code or media reuse permission inferred.

records.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
records.evidence_scope: Official store lists release September 17, 2025; do not label current game Early Access
observations: Mining changes movement opportunities while automatic weapons handle firing.
Procedural caves, mission objectives and timed extraction structure encounters.
records.design_interpretation: Resource POIs should make route decisions under pressure, not be stationary loot buttons.
acceptance: Test routes remain navigable after mining.
Measure objective completion and extraction readability under peak enemy load.
records.reuse: Original analysis only; no code or media reuse permission inferred.

records.name: Diablo III Paragon 2.0.1
records.evidence_scope: Historical patch v2.0.1.22044, not every subsequent season
observations: This patch removes the Paragon-level cap.
Levels are account-wide with Hardcore and Normal tracked separately.
records.design_interpretation: An uncapped account progression track is a valid design inspiration; isolate incompatible progression realms.
acceptance: Test high-level numeric limits, save migrations and XP rollover.
Separate prestige display from unbounded combat-stat inflation.
records.reuse: Original analysis only; no code or media reuse permission inferred.

records.name: Diablo IV Paragon 2.0
records.evidence_scope: Historical 2.0 patch series, not current season claim
observations: Patch specifies maximum Paragon level 300 and five boards including starting board.
Glyph experience moves to the Pit.
records.design_interpretation: Diablo IV is not evidence of uncapped Paragon in this version. Preserve user uncapped target as our own design requirement, not a borrowed factual claim.
acceptance: Mark patch scope in comparison views.
Do not automatically convert capped progression into uncapped claims.
records.reuse: Original analysis only; no code or media reuse permission inferred.

records.name: Halls of Torment
records.evidence_scope: Official store feature list, not hands-on validation
observations: Developer specifies 30-minute runs and quest-driven metaprogression.
Items can be extracted to customize later runs; class marks enable combining class powers.
Late-game Shrine of Torment and rare item variants are described.
records.design_interpretation: Combine run builds, extraction and longer-term goals instead of making longer timers the whole endgame.
acceptance: Separate run XP, retained equipment and account unlocks.
records.reuse: Original analysis only; no code or media reuse permission inferred.

records.name: Path of Exile 2
records.evidence_scope: Observed store Early Access tag; review status again before release decisions
observations: Developer describes endgame biomes, crafting, bosses and special encounters.
Endgame passive trees alter mechanics and rewards alongside difficulty.
records.design_interpretation: Offer player-directed endgame specialization and visible risk/reward; retain exact observed build before numerical balancing.
acceptance: Keep live vs announced features separate.
Test multiple viable routes and publish limitations rather than assert equal scope.
records.reuse: Original analysis only; no code or media reuse permission inferred.

records.name: Path of Exile Siege of the Atlas
records.evidence_scope: Historical expansion design, not current league rules
observations: Atlas specialization, pinnacle bosses and endgame crafting are presented as connected systems.
Boss progression leads through influenced maps and subordinate encounters.
records.design_interpretation: Endgame depth comes from meaningful specialization, progression routes and build-testing bosses, not time inflation.
acceptance: Track distinct encounter families, viable builds and reward routes.
Do not label a timer extension as PoE-level endgame.
records.reuse: Original analysis only; no code or media reuse permission inferred.

records.name: Vampire Survivors
records.evidence_scope: Official store description reviewed; no patch-level mechanics audit
observations: Gold earned during a run purchases upgrades for later survivors.
Power-up refunds are free according to the developer tips.
records.design_interpretation: Make persistent growth understandable and experimentation reversible. This does not prove every mode has unlimited progression.
acceptance: Show next unlock, refund preview and post-run gains.
records.reuse: Original analysis only; no code or media reuse permission inferred.
